n: Another word from the Lord, this time affecting Jeremiah’s personal life.
God tells Jeremiah not to marry or have children in this land. In a culture where marriage and children were expected and treasured, his single life became a living sign of the coming disaster.

f.w: Thou shalt not take thee a wife

n: Here’s why: consider the children born in this land and their parents…
…they will die terrible deaths—from disease, sword, and famine—unmourned and unburied, their bodies food for birds and beasts.

f.w: they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth

n: Don’t enter a house of mourning or comfort the bereaved, for God has withdrawn His peace, steadfast love, and mercy from this people. Jeremiah’s absence from funerals was itself a message.

f.w: I have taken away my peace from this people
lovingkindness

n: Great and small will die unburied and unmourned. No one will cut themselves or shave their heads for them—pagan mourning customs the law forbade but which people still practiced.

f.w: nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald

n: No one will break bread to comfort mourners or offer the “cup of consolation” for a lost father or mother. Even the rituals of comfort will disappear.

f.w: tear themselves
f.g: Better: “break bread”—a funeral meal for mourners.

f.w: the cup of consolation
f.g: A cup of wine given to comfort mourners.

n: Nor should Jeremiah join any feast. He abstains from both mourning and celebrating.

f.w: the house of feasting

n: In your own lifetime, God will silence all joy—the sounds of celebration and weddings.

f.w: the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride

n: When the people hear this, they’ll ask, “What have we done? What sin deserves all this?” They seem genuinely blind to their guilt.

f.w: what is our iniquity?

n: Answer: your ancestors abandoned Me, followed other gods, and didn’t keep My law.

f.w: Because your fathers have forsaken me

n: And you’ve done worse than they did, each following his stubborn, evil heart and refusing to listen.

f.w: ye have done worse than your fathers

n: So God will throw you out into a land you never knew, and there you’ll serve other gods day and night—getting what you wanted, with no favor from Him.

f.w: there shall ye serve other gods day and night

n: Suddenly, hope breaks in: a day is coming when people will no longer swear “As the Lord lives, who brought Israel out of Egypt”…

f.w: that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt

n: …but “As the Lord lives, who brought Israel back from the north and from every land where He scattered them.” The future gathering will outshine even the Exodus. Latter-day Saints see this fulfilled in the latter-day gathering of Israel, including from the “north countries.”

f.w: from the land of the north
I will bring them again into their land

n: God will send many fishermen to catch them and then many hunters to search every mountain, hill, and cave. In context this may describe enemies hunting the guilty, but Latter-day Saints have often applied it to missionaries gathering scattered Israel.

f.w: I will send for many fishers
many hunters

n: God’s eyes are on all their ways; nothing is hidden from Him, including their sins.

f.w: mine eyes are upon all their ways

n: First, though, He will repay their sin in full, because they polluted His land with the lifeless “corpses” of their idols.

f.w: double
f.g: In full, to the complete measure.

f.w: the carcases of their detestable and abominable things
f.g: Lifeless idols, pictured as corpses defiling the land.

n: Jeremiah responds with a prayer of faith: Lord, my strength, fortress, and refuge, nations will come from the ends of the earth and confess, “Our ancestors inherited nothing but lies and worthless idols.” A vision of the Gentiles turning to God.

f.w: O LORD, my strength, and my fortress
our fathers have inherited lies

n: Can people make their own gods? Such things are not gods at all.

f.w: they are no gods

n: So this time God will teach them—show them His hand and power—and they will know that His name is the Lord (Jehovah).

f.w: they shall know that my name is The LORD
